note: Hard paraphrase set (2026-10-16): how preachers really put verses — loose wording, allusions and fragments, West African preaching style — and decoys that sound like scripture but are no verse (declarations, sayings, church notices). Every ref checked against the KJV text. 'narrative' lines retell a Bible story: suggesting the passage is fine, putting it on screen is not; not scored by semantic_bench.
